# Glossary

**base rule** — the line for `/` in `zugriff.txt`; it applies to
everything without a more specific line.

**benutzer.txt** — users with groups and password hash
(`name;groups;hash`, `--users`), outside the root.

**book landing page** — page generated by mdserver from `book.tcl` for
a book folder without `index.md`: title, subtitle, README paragraph,
downloads, chapters.

**breadcrumbs** — path line above the text in style `site`: Start ›
folder title › page title.

**card** — tile for a book, a folder or a document on a directory page
in style `site`.

**clean URL** — path without `.md`; the server looks for the file with
the extension, also in subfolders.

**concurrency** — one coroutine per connection, non-blocking I/O, all
in one thread.

**connection limit** — at most so many open connections, in all
(`--maxconn`) and per client (`--maxperaddr`); over that 503.

**control port** — localhost channel `ping`, `status`, `reload`, `stop`
(`mdctl.tcl`).

**dark mode** — dark colours in style `site`; following the system
setting or via `theme=dunkel`.

**document root** — `--root`, the document tree.

**full-text search** — `/?q=words` over all `.md` files of the root,
with tclutils also over PDFs, ANDed.

**gast** — group everybody has, even without logging in (guest); a
folder with `gast` is public.

**group** — name in `zugriff.txt` and `benutzer.txt` through which
rights are given.

**health endpoint** — default `/__mdserver/health`.

**listen address** — address on which mdserver accepts connections
(`--bind`); default `127.0.0.1`, `*` for all interfaces.

**login** — HTTP Basic over HTTPS against `benutzer.txt`; the password
is checked with PBKDF2, five failures lock the address for 10 minutes.

**manual page** — a man page converted to Markdown, first H1 `# NAME`;
mdserver names it after `CommandName` or the NAME line.

**mitarbeiter** — group everybody logged in has (staff).

**module path** — where the launcher looks for modules: `lib/`,
`MDSTACK_LIB`, `DOCIR_TM`, the neighbouring folders `../mdstack/lib` and
`../docir/lib/tm`.

**office view** — a `.docx`, `.odt`, `.odp`, `.xlsx` or `.ods` as a
page instead of a download (`--office-view`).

**page cache** — finished office and CSV pages, kept until the file
changes (`--viewcache`).

**PDF worker** — a `tclsh` of its own per PDF (`lib/pdftext-worker.tcl`)
that reads the text for the search, so that the server keeps answering.

**range** — part of a file (206), for large PDFs.

**search index** — text, title and words of all searched files, each
with its mtime; built in the background after the start.

**search tips** — foldable help on the search syntax on the result
page, with examples from the documents themselves.

**settings file** — all options in one file, one per line
(`--config`); relative paths from the folder of the file.

**site style** — default page style: whole layout with header bar,
sidebar, breadcrumbs, `Auf dieser Seite`.

**trusted proxy** — peers whose `X-Forwarded-For` counts
(`--trusted-proxy`).

**umlaut folding** — the search treats `ae`, `oe`, `ue`, `ss` like `ä`,
`ö`, `ü`, `ß`.

**who sees what** — tab of the GUI ("Wer sieht was") that shows, for a
reader, which folders they see.

**zugriff.txt** — rights per path (`path;groups`, `--access`); the
longest matching line wins.
